about: Origin Engine's style catalogue: 37 art styles in the engine's own words, each with what a critic checks on a rendered frame and what it must not hold as a defect (`intended`: the traits that look like defects but are the style, such as hard pixel steps, dither or broken edges; it never names the style, so a blind critic reads it too), the premises it fits, the look preset it maps to (an .ogt of type look; `extends "<slug>"` in a game's own look builds on it), the built-in UI style its look's `ui` line names, palette and asset specs, and an art-bible direction the agent expands per project. `preview` is a picture of the style as a game, 960x540 (previews/<slug>.webp against the root of the package that carries the catalogue: @origingame/engine/knowledge and @origingame/create-game; not in the platform mount, whose payload is text). `look.layers` names what the style needs: frame (the look's render resources), conform (the cook makes the assets meet the look's art contract), runtime (sprite outline, palette swap, pixel-art rotation, camera presets), authored (art no conformance makes); `look.support` follows from them: full when every layer but authored is implemented, content when authored art is needed, partial otherwise, with `missing` naming what, and a content style's `look.authored` the art it needs, each a kind of the art brief and what it must be (artBrief asks for exactly that, docs/art.md). `category` groups the styles in plain terms (`categories` names each group); `look.views` lists the views it suits (side-2d, top-down-2d, isometric-2.5d, third-person-3d, first-person-3d: the creation choice's words), only those its profiles draw; `look.mood` is the mood its preset is drawn in, one of bright, dark, warm, cold, soft and high-contrast, any of which a game's look may ask for instead (docs/art.md §2.10). The `art-review` guide (`og api show art-review`) explains how to use it. The descriptions are original; no game or studio is the reference for a style.
artBibleTemplate: Art bible for {title}. Premise: {premise}. Camera: {camera}; platform and display size: {platform}. Style: {name} ({descriptor}) Direction: {direction} Palette: {palette}. Asset specs: {assets}. UI: the {ui} style the preset names (a `ui` line in the game's look picks another, or the game's own styles/<name>/style.ogt), re-coloured to this palette. Avoid: {avoid}. Proof: the game's look is assets/looks/{game}.ogt, extending "{slug}"; capture the title, play and results screens with og run and check each against: {checks}. Every later asset is made inside this bible; a request for one asset never redesigns the style.

styles.name: Expressionist paint
styles.descriptor: Visible brush marks, clashing colour masses and distorted faces turn every frame into an emotional painting.
checks: Large areas show brush-stroke texture rather than flat fills or gradients.
Colours are non-naturalistic: shadows carry saturated hues (greens, violets) instead of grey.
Edges between colour masses are broken and uneven, never clean vector curves.
styles.intended: Uneven brush marks, broken edges between colour masses, distorted faces and non-naturalistic shadow hues are the style, not unfinished art or colour errors.

missing: the painting is content: painted portraits and backdrops

authored.what: painted by hand in thick, visible brush strokes: the face distorted for feeling, shadows in saturated greens and violets, edges between colour masses broken
painted by hand as one canvas: three to five clashing colour masses, every surface carrying the brush, no photographic texture or clean gradient

palette.size: free, but 3 to 5 dominant masses per scene
palette.rules: Complementary clashes in shadows; one dominant temperature per scene; avoid neutral greys.

artBible.direction: Paint first: masses before detail, colour for emotion rather than light, faces allowed to distort, every surface carrying the hand.

styles.name: Bold comic illustration
styles.descriptor: Strong contours, sharply grouped values and saturated accents against deep shadow, for instant readability in motion.
checks: Every character has a continuous dark contour at least 2 px wide at 1080p.
Shadows are hard-edged shapes, two or three values per material.
Saturated accents cover under 15 % of the frame and sit on the characters or pickups.
styles.intended: Thick dark contours, hard-edged two- or three-value shadows and large areas of near-black are the style, not heavy outlines or crushed shadows.

palette.rules: Deep warm or cool shadow colour shared by all materials; accents in one hue family per faction.

assets.spriteScale: characters 120 to 200 px tall on screen
assets.textureDensity: hand-painted textures, 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Graphic shapes, hard shadows, thick confident lines, colour reserved for what matters, poses pushed for silhouette.

styles.name: Watercolour wash
styles.descriptor: Transparent layers, pooled pigment at the edges and open paper space give scenes a soft, breathing quality.
checks: Colour regions show darker rims where they meet other colours (pigment pooling).
A paper grain is visible in flat areas at 100 %.
At least a quarter of the frame is light, unpainted or nearly unpainted space.
styles.intended: Darker pigment rims, uneven washes, visible paper grain and large unpainted light areas are the style, not banding, noise or missing art.

premise.genre: exploration platformer, narrative puzzle, relaxing adventure

palette.rules: Light values dominate; two or three pigments mixed into the rest; no pure black.

assets.textureDensity: textures 0.5 to 1 texel per screen pixel, wash-painted

artBible.direction: Layered translucent washes, edges that pool and bloom, white paper as light, depth by overlapping washes and haze.
avoid: everything equally soft (the player must stay crisp)

styles.name: Pixel sprites in 3D sets
styles.descriptor: Pixel-art characters and props stand in lit 3D sets with depth of field, shadows and reflections, while their own edges stay crisp.
checks: Sprite edges stay on their own pixel grid while the 3D set is smoothly shaded behind them.
Foreground and background blur by depth (depth of field visible at the frame's top and bottom).
Sprites cast or receive shadows that agree with the set's sun.
styles.intended: Hard-edged unsmoothed sprites standing in a smoothly shaded, depth-blurred set are the style: the contrast between the two is intended, not a resolution mismatch.

palette.size: sprites 32 to 64 colours; the set is unconstrained but graded to match
palette.rules: Grade the 3D set with a LUT towards the sprites' palette so the two read as one world.

assets.logicalResolution: native output, sprites authored at 1/4 to 1/6 scale
assets.textureDensity: textures 1 to 2 texels per screen pixel; sprites nearest-filtered

artBible.direction: Crisp pixel figures in miniature lit sets: tilt-shift depth of field, warm light shafts, soft bloom, everything framed by a slightly high camera.
avoid: photoreal sets that out-detail the characters

styles.name: Faceted low poly
styles.descriptor: Visible polygon facets and simplified meshes, broad colour fields in place of textures, depth from silhouettes and layers.
checks: Facets are visible: each triangle shades flat with a hard edge to its neighbour.
Surfaces carry flat colour, not detailed textures.
Depth reads by value: farther layers are lighter or lower in contrast than nearer ones, and the play area keeps full contrast.
styles.intended: Hard edges between flat-shaded triangles and untextured colour fields are the style, not missing smooth normals or missing textures.

palette.rules: Colour per material, gradients only from lighting and fog.

artBible.direction: Planar facets, flat material colours, depth from value and silhouette, fog only beyond the play area, silhouettes designed from few polygons.
avoid: high polygon counts that hide the facets

styles.name: Sculpted clay
styles.descriptor: Tactile, slightly lumpy surfaces with blunt edges and fingerprint irregularity, often moving with the stutter of stop motion.
checks: Surfaces show soft bumps and irregularities (normal or displacement detail) at close range.
Edges are rounded and blunt; no sharp machined corners.
Animation holds poses for 2 or more ticks (stepped, not interpolated).
styles.intended: Lumpy, slightly irregular surfaces, blunt edges and animation that holds poses for several ticks are the style, not modelling defects or dropped frames.

missing: sculpted forms: chunky, rounded, hand-modelled characters and props (the engine draws the clay surface, MaterialStyle.surface clay, and bevels on whatever it is given; primitive blockouts stay primitives and do not read as clay at play distance)

authored.what: hand-modelled in clay: chunky, rounded, slightly lumpy forms with thumb-pressed dents, thick limbs and no thin parts; the engine adds the clay surface and bevels, the forms must be clay already
hand-modelled in clay: chunky, rounded, soft-cornered forms with uneven, pressed surfaces; never a primitive blockout

palette.rules: Matte surfaces; saturation from the clay, not the light.

assets.textureDensity: normal maps with thumb-print detail, 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Matte modelling clay, blunt forms, visible handling marks, miniature depth of field, poses held like stop motion.

styles.name: Early console pixels
styles.descriptor: Tiny sprites, a handful of hard colour steps per ramp and tiles that repeat on a strict grid, read at a glance like the first home consoles.
checks: Zoomed to 400 %, every edge in the play area sits on one logical pixel grid: no half pixels, no smoothing.
A capture holds at most 16 distinct colours outside the UI, and each sprite uses at most 4.
Characters are 16 to 24 logical pixels tall and readable as silhouettes when filled black.
styles.intended: Hard one-pixel steps, aliased edges, very few colours per sprite and visibly repeating tiles are the style, not missing antialiasing, banding or a low-effort palette.

palette.rules: Ramps of 3 or 4 steps per material; one shared black; no gradients; background colours darker or desaturated against sprites.

assets.spriteScale: 16 x 16 to 16 x 24 characters, 8 x 8 or 16 x 16 tiles

artBible.direction: Flat colour blocks with hard edges, readable shapes before surface detail, sprites drawn on an exact grid, tiles that repeat honestly, animation in few frames with strong key poses.
avoid: colour counts that drift between assets

styles.name: Voxel worlds
styles.descriptor: Cubes build characters, architecture and terrain, visible in stepped silhouettes and broken edges, under any lighting.
checks: Silhouettes are stepped: every edge is made of axis-aligned cubes.
The cube size is consistent across characters and environment (or in clear multiples).
Faces shade flat; light changes per face, not per pixel gradient on a face.
styles.intended: Stepped, jagged silhouettes made of cubes and flat per-face shading are the style, not aliasing or missing smooth shading.

palette.rules: One palette for the whole world; shade by light, not by palette steps.

artBible.direction: Everything from cubes of one size, palette-coloured faces, strong ambient occlusion in corners, destruction that reveals the grid.

styles.name: Manuscript page
styles.descriptor: Scenes composed like a decorated page: flat figures, ink lines, ornamental borders and lettering woven into the image.
checks: The frame has an ornamental border or margin occupying at least 5 % of its area.
Figures are flat (no cast shadows or form shading beyond line).
Text in the UI uses a calligraphic or book face and sits inside the composition, not in floating boxes.
styles.intended: Flat figures without cast shadows, ink lines, wide ornamental margins and lettering inside the picture are the style, not missing lighting or a cramped layout.

premise.genre: narrative mystery, historical adventure, card games

missing: the page is content: figures, borders and lettering

authored.what: drawn as a manuscript figure: flat, stylised, in profile or three-quarter, ink contours filled with flat pigment and gold leaf, no cast shadows
an illuminated page border: interlaced vines, knotwork and gold, drawn by hand around a plain vellum centre
a decorated initial or marginal flourish drawn by hand: ink line, flat pigment and gold leaf on vellum

palette.rules: Parchment ground, iron-gall ink, a few mineral pigments (ultramarine, vermilion, verdigris) and gold.

artBible.direction: Flat drawn figures in ink and mineral colour, borders and initials as structure, text as part of the picture.

styles.name: Rubber-hose cartoon
styles.descriptor: Round-headed characters with bendy tube limbs, pie-cut eyes and constant squash and stretch, inked like early theatrical cartoons.
checks: Limbs bend in smooth curves without elbows or knees.
Animation shows squash and stretch on every anticipation and landing.
Film grain or gate weave is visible on the full frame.
styles.intended: Film grain, gate weave, tapered heavy ink lines and constant squash and stretch are the style, not noise, camera shake or deformation bugs.

missing: frame-by-frame animation is content: flipbooks drawn on 12s

authored.what: drawn frame by frame for animation on 12s: limbs as bending hoses without elbows or knees, white gloves, pie-cut eyes, a bouncing squash and stretch in every pose, heavy black ink
drawn frame by frame on 12s as one flipbook sheet, each frame a new drawing, never one drawing moved or rotated

palette.size: sepia or muted primaries, 12 to 24 colours
palette.rules: Inked black lines, flat fills, a warm faded grade over everything.

assets.textureDensity: frames drawn at 24 fps, played on twos

artBible.direction: Bouncy hand animation, tapered ink, flat fills, a faded film print over the whole frame, every idle pose alive.

styles.name: Pencil and hatching
styles.descriptor: Shadow built from line density and direction over paper, in greys or sepia, whether drawn flat or wrapped around 3D forms.
checks: Shadows are made of parallel lines whose density increases with darkness; no smooth gradients.
Paper grain is visible in light areas.
The capture is greyscale or within one hue (sepia) except for at most one accent.
styles.intended: Parallel hatch lines in place of gradients, visible paper grain and an almost colourless frame are the style, not noise, moiré or a washed-out grade.

palette.size: graphite or sepia ramp plus paper, optional single accent
palette.rules: Value from line density only; the accent marks danger or the goal.

assets.textureDensity: paper texture 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Graphite on paper: hatch direction follows form, darkness from density, edges wobble slightly, paper shows through.

styles.name: Gothic ornament
styles.descriptor: Clean-contoured simple characters inside intricate, curling architecture and misty depth, dark but delicate.
checks: Characters are simple shapes with minimal facial detail and clean outlines.
Backgrounds contain dense curling ornament or pointed arches in at least two depth layers.
Farther layers fade into haze or glow behind the play area, and the play area keeps full contrast.
styles.intended: Characters drawn as simple shapes with little facial detail against dense ornament, and far layers lost in haze or glow, are the style, not unfinished characters or fog bugs.

missing: ornament is content: architecture and characters drawn for the style

authored.what: gothic architecture drawn for the style: pointed arches, tracery and spires in long dark contours over muted washes
drawn for the style: elongated figures in flowing garments, outlined in long dark contours with ornament worked into the clothes

palette.size: cool desaturated base with 1 or 2 glowing accents
palette.rules: Dark blue-grey grounds, pale characters, glows in one hue.

artBible.direction: Simple bright characters against intricate dark architecture, layered haze, soft halos on light sources.

styles.name: Lush opaque painting
styles.descriptor: Opaque, weighty colour masses with selective brushwork and rich warm-cool contrast build dense painted environments.
checks: Large areas are opaque painted masses with visible but selective brushwork.
Lit surfaces are warm and shadows cool (or the reverse) across the whole frame.
The environment is dense but layered: what is nearer the camera, the play plane and what lies beyond or beneath it separate by value.
styles.intended: Visible brushwork in opaque masses and a strong warm-light, cool-shadow split are the style, not texture noise or a colour cast.

premise.genre: action RPG, isometric adventure, story platformer

missing: painted backdrops are content; Stylise.paint* for 3D props

authored.what: painted by hand in opaque gouache-like strokes: rich, saturated layers of foliage, sky and stone, depth by colour temperature, every area painted rather than textured

palette.size: free, organised by warm light and cool shadow
palette.rules: Saturation highest at the light's edge; value grouping in three planes.

assets.textureDensity: hand-painted at 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Opaque painting with weight, warm light and cool shadow, brushwork saved for focal areas, rich layered detail.

styles.name: Storybook ornament
styles.descriptor: Gentle contours, patterned plants and soft colour shapes make explorable picture-book worlds.
checks: Contours are thin and gentle, slightly darker than the fill rather than black.
Vegetation and props carry repeating decorative patterns.
Depth comes from overlapping flat planes, not from perspective shading.
styles.intended: Thin contours a shade darker than the fill, repeating decorative patterns and depth from overlapping flat planes are the style, not weak outlines, tiling or missing perspective.

premise.genre: cosy adventure, crafting, puzzle, children's games

missing: illustration is content; Stylise.ink and paintCanvas

authored.what: illustrated by hand like a picture-book spread: patterned foliage, decorative borders and flat ornamented shapes over a textured paper
illustrated by hand like a picture-book character: simple charming shapes, patterned clothes and an ink line

palette.rules: Soft saturated hues, coloured line work, patterns from the same palette.

artBible.direction: Flat illustrated planes, ornamental plants and patterns, gentle coloured lines, overlapping layers for space.

styles.name: Old-master collage
styles.descriptor: Figures and landscapes from classical painting recombined into moving scenes, oil surfaces meeting visible cut seams.
checks: Surfaces show oil-painting texture (craquelure, glazing, brushwork).
Cut edges between elements are visible and deliberate.
Characters move as cut-out pieces (rotating parts), not as smooth deformation.
styles.intended: Craquelure, visible cut seams between elements and characters moving as rotating cut-out pieces are the style, not compositing errors or broken rigs.

missing: the source paintings and cut-outs are content (public-domain scans or original painting); no engine primitive is missing

authored.what: painted in the manner of an old-master oil, original work: glazed light, dark varnished ground, a classical landscape or interior
an old-master painted figure cut out along its silhouette with a hard paper edge, ready to be moved as a cut-out puppet

palette.rules: Grade all sources to a common varnish tone with a LUT.

assets.textureDensity: scans at 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Painted fragments reassembled with visible seams, puppet-like movement, a common varnish grade.
avoid: sources with mismatched lighting left ungraded

styles.name: Fine-line doodle worlds
styles.descriptor: Countless tiny people and objects drawn with simple, slightly irregular lines, like a giant hand-drawn map.
checks: Lines are thin (1 to 2 px) and slightly irregular.
A capture shows at least 30 separate small figures or objects.
Shading is minimal: forms read by line, not by light.
styles.intended: Thin, slightly irregular hand-drawn lines, minimal shading and a frame crowded with tiny figures are the style, not shaky rendering, missing lighting or clutter.

missing: the drawing is content; Stylise.ink can outline 3D props to match

authored.what: drawn by hand in fine black pen: dense, busy doodled detail, hatching and tiny objects filling every area
drawn by hand in fine black pen with doodled detail and a few flat colour fills
drawn by hand in fine black pen, every surface filled with small doodled detail

palette.size: monochrome ink or 4 to 8 light colours
palette.rules: White or off-white ground; colour never hides line.

artBible.direction: Hand-drawn line everywhere, dense miniature scenes side by side, very little shading, humour in the details.

styles.name: Black-figure pottery
styles.descriptor: Flat dark silhouettes with fine incised detail on ochre grounds, framed by meanders and horizontal bands.
checks: The capture is within an ochre-and-black palette plus at most one extra colour.
Figures are solid silhouettes with thin lighter detail lines inside.
The composition is organised in horizontal bands with patterned borders.
styles.intended: A frame of two to four colours, solid dark silhouettes with thin incised lines and banded borders are the style, not a dull palette or missing shading.

missing: silhouettes are content; Stylise.palette locks the colours

authored.what: a black-figure silhouette: the figure solid glossy black on terracotta, its details incised as thin terracotta lines, in strict profile
a black-figure silhouette: solid black on terracotta with incised details, in strict profile

palette.rules: Ochre ground, black figures, a lighter line colour, optional red-brown.

artBible.direction: Silhouette action, incised details, banded friezes and meanders, a fixed two-tone palette.

styles.name: Heavy ink and shadow
styles.descriptor: Solid black shadows, rough hatching and muted colour shape distorted figures, with highlights saved for danger.
checks: At least 30 % of a capture is solid black or near-black.
Transitions from light to shadow use rough hatching, not gradients.
Bright highlights appear only on characters, threats or interactables.
styles.intended: Large areas of solid black, rough hatching instead of gradients and muted colour are the style, not crushed blacks, noise or a dim grade.

palette.rules: Desaturated mid-tones, black for every shadow, one blood or fire accent.

artBible.direction: Black masses carry the mood, rough ink hatching shapes form, proportions distorted, light is rare and meaningful.

styles.name: One-ink pixels
styles.descriptor: Black and white (or one ink on one paper) pixels where silhouette and negative space do the work, with at most one accent for signals.
checks: A capture contains 2 main colours covering at least 95 % of pixels; any third colour marks an interactable or danger.
Every sprite reads as a silhouette on the ground: no mid-tones inside shapes.
Text and HUD use the same two colours.
styles.intended: Two colours covering nearly the whole frame, no mid-tones inside shapes and hard one-pixel steps are the style, not a broken palette or a contrast fault.

palette.rules: Pick ink and paper first; shading only through dither or pattern; the accent means one thing.

artBible.direction: Two values, crisp silhouettes, patterns in place of shading, negative space as composition, one accent with one meaning.

styles.name: Late console pixels
styles.descriptor: Fuller sprites with ramped shading, parallax layers behind the action and saturated colour, the richer pixel language of the following hardware generation.
checks: Background layers scroll at visibly different rates and never at the playfield's speed.
Shading on sprites steps through 4 to 6 tones per material with no smooth gradients.
Edges stay on the logical pixel grid when the camera moves (compare two captures 1 s apart at 400 %).
styles.intended: Hard one-pixel steps, four to six flat tones per material with no smooth gradient, and outlines broken by light are the style, not banding, missing antialiasing or gaps in the line.

palette.rules: Ramps of 4 to 6 steps; hue-shifted shadows (cooler) and highlights (warmer); saturated accents on characters, calmer backgrounds.

assets.outlinePx: 1 dark pixel, selectively broken by light

artBible.direction: Volume from stepped shading, layered parallax for depth, lively multi-frame animation, saturated colour kept to the characters and pickups so the playfield reads.
avoid: parallax layers that match the playfield speed

styles.name: Dense illustrative pixels
styles.descriptor: Pixel art pushed towards illustration: rich clusters, subtle hue shifts and detailed scenery, with the pixel grid still visible on close look.
checks: At 400 %, single-pixel clusters form textures (bark, stone, cloth) rather than flat fills.
Each material shows at least 6 tones with visible hue shifts between them.
Characters still read against the scenery: a greyscale capture separates them by value.
styles.intended: Single-pixel clusters and dither forming texture, and a pixel grid visible up close, are the style, not noise or an upscaling artefact.

premise.genre: exploration, adventure, interconnected platformers, narrative platformers

palette.rules: Long hue-shifted ramps; a value plan per scene that keeps the play area mid-value and the foreground darkest.

artBible.direction: Hand-placed pixel clusters that describe material, light that pools and glows, scenery as rich as the characters but quieter in value.
avoid: noise textures standing in for clusters
detail in the play path that hides hazards

styles.name: Glowing pixels on dark ground
styles.descriptor: Pixel scenes built on dark bases where saturated light sources, rim highlights and glow carry the composition.
checks: Mean luminance of a play capture is below 0.25 while the brightest 2 % of pixels are above 0.8.
Light sources show a halo (bloom or glow) wider than the source itself.
The player character is lit from at least one local light, not only ambient.
styles.intended: A mostly dark frame with a few saturated light sources, glow halos wider than their sources and hard pixel steps are the style, not underexposure, bloom bleed or aliasing.

premise.genre: action adventure, twin-stick, cyber and sci-fi exploration

palette.rules: A near-black ground with two or three saturated light hues; no mid-grey fills; accents reserved for interactables.

artBible.direction: Dark masses and bright accents; light defines form, glow marks what matters, colour leads the eye through the level.
avoid: bright backgrounds that drown the accents

styles.name: Top-down tile worlds
styles.descriptor: Overhead or three-quarter tile maps with upright sprites, where steps, cliffs and overlap make height and paths readable.
checks: Walkable floor, walls and drops are distinguishable in a greyscale capture.
Characters are drawn upright and are occluded by tall tiles in front of them (y-sorting works).
Tile seams are invisible: no gaps or bleeding lines between tiles at any camera position.
styles.intended: Hard pixel steps, a repeating tile grid and upright sprites drawn over the top-down map are the style, not aliasing, tiling or perspective errors.

premise.genre: action RPG, tactics, farming and life sims, overhead adventure

palette.rules: Floors desaturated and mid-value; walls darker on their faces; characters most saturated.

assets.spriteScale: 16 x 16 tiles, 16 x 24 to 24 x 32 characters

artBible.direction: A strict tile grid, height told by wall faces and drop shadows, upright characters sorted by their feet, paths readable before decoration.
avoid: decoration on walkable paths that hides edges

styles.name: Low-resolution 3D
styles.descriptor: Simplified models, small textures and pixelated output recall early 3D consoles, often with modern lighting on top.
checks: The frame is rendered at 240 to 360 logical lines and scaled up with nearest filtering.
Textures show large visible texels (64 to 256 px textures on whole characters).
Vertices wobble or snap as the camera moves (compare two captures).
styles.intended: A low-resolution frame scaled up with nearest filtering, large visible texels and vertices that snap as the camera moves are the style, not upscaling blur, texture loss or jitter bugs.

palette.size: free, but posterised to 32 levels per channel
palette.rules: Fog colour equals the clear colour; dithered gradients.

artBible.direction: A low-resolution frame with nearest upscaling, wobbling vertices and warped textures, short fog beyond the play area, modern light where it helps mood.

styles.name: Minimal low-count pixels
styles.descriptor: Very few pixels per figure, no faces and almost no texture: silhouettes, empty space and a few colour masses carry mood and story.
checks: Characters are at most 12 logical pixels tall and have no facial features.
At least 40 % of a capture is a flat background mass.
Large colour masses (sky, floor, walls) each use a single colour.
styles.intended: Figures a few pixels tall with no faces, single-colour masses and large empty areas are the style, not missing detail or unfinished backgrounds.

palette.rules: Each scene has one dominant mass colour; detail colour only where the eye should go.

artBible.direction: Reduction as a choice: suggest, never render; leave space empty; let sound and timing do what detail would.
avoid: high logical resolutions that soften the reduction

styles.name: Anime cel-shaded 3D
styles.descriptor: 3D models drawn with the hard shadow shapes and contour lines of 2D animation, framed and timed like an anime cut.
checks: Shadows on characters are one or two hard-edged bands, no smooth gradients.
Characters have a dark contour whose width is consistent at the same distance.
Shadow colour is tinted (cool or warm), not black or grey.
styles.intended: Hard one- or two-band shadows with no gradient, tinted shadow colour and contour lines are the style, not banding, a colour cast or outline artefacts.

palette.rules: Two tones per material (lit, shadow) with hue-shifted shadows; highlights as shapes.

assets.spriteScale: characters 120 to 300 px tall on screen
assets.textureDensity: flat or lightly painted, 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Cel shadows as designed shapes, lines that thin with distance, tinted shadows, dynamic camera and impact frames.
avoid: outlines of uniform screen width at every distance

styles.name: Inked comic 3D
styles.descriptor: Volumetric models keep bold outlines, drawn surface marks and exaggerated colour: a comic page given depth.
checks: Thick black outlines on silhouettes and major creases.
Ink marks (hatching or strokes) are painted onto surfaces.
Proportions are exaggerated (oversized hands, heads or weapons).
styles.intended: Thick black outlines, ink strokes painted onto surfaces and exaggerated proportions are the style, not outline artefacts, dirty textures or broken models.

palette.rules: Bold local colours, black ink for all shadow edges.

assets.textureDensity: hand-inked textures, 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Comic ink over 3D: heavy outlines, hatched shading painted in, punchy colour, exaggerated shapes.

styles.name: Paper craft
styles.descriptor: Folded planes, visible sheet thickness and layered cut paper become the world's construction.
checks: Surfaces are flat planes with crisp folds; no smooth organic curvature.
Paper grain or fibre is visible on lit surfaces.
Layered sheets cast soft contact shadows on the layer behind.
styles.intended: Crisp folds on flat planes, visible fibre and soft contact shadows between stacked sheets are the style, not low-poly faceting, noise or ambient-occlusion bugs.

missing: the art is content: models built as card sheets with the paper fold recipe (templates/looks/paper-craft/models: folded cones, cut card hills stood in layers, a card plateau); the engine draws the card grain (MaterialStyle.surface paper) on whatever it is given

authored.what: built as folded card: flat sheets with crisp folds, scored edges and visible thickness, no curved surfaces (the paper fold recipe)
built as card sheets folded and stood in layers, crisp creases and flat faces (the paper fold recipe)

palette.rules: Colours of real paper stock: muted, slightly warm; white is off-white.

assets.spriteScale: characters as 200 to 600 triangle folded shapes
assets.textureDensity: paper texture 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Everything is cut, folded or stacked paper: planar facets, thin edges, soft contact shadows, paper grain.

styles.name: Miniature diorama
styles.descriptor: High, often isometric framing, small rounded architecture and soft shadows make the world look like a tabletop model.
checks: Depth of field blurs the frame's top and bottom bands (tilt-shift).
Shadows are soft with strong ambient occlusion in corners.
The camera looks down at 30 to 60 degrees.
styles.intended: Blurred top and bottom bands, soft shadows with strong corner occlusion and a high downward camera are the style, not focus or lighting faults.

premise.genre: city builder, cosy building, puzzle, tactics

missing: a tabletop scene: toy-scale props and buildings on a bounded base seen from 30 to 60 degrees above (the engine draws tilt-shift, plastic and painted-wood surfaces and bevels; a low camera over a few primitives does not read as a model)

authored.what: a toy-scale model on a tabletop: chunky simplified buildings and props of painted wood and plastic, rounded edges, sized for a bounded base seen from 30 to 60 degrees above
a toy figure: chunky, simplified, painted plastic or wood with a small base

palette.rules: Bright but slightly desaturated; warm sunlight, cool shadows.

assets.textureDensity: simple colour textures or vertex colour

artBible.direction: Toy-scale world: rounded bevels, tilt-shift focus, soft sun and occlusion, high camera.

styles.name: Painterly 3D
styles.descriptor: 3D spaces whose simplified materials, shaped forms and painterly colour step away from the photographic.
checks: Surfaces show brushy, broad colour regions rather than photo detail.
Forms are deliberately shaped and exaggerated (architecture leans, props chunky).
Colour is harmonised across the frame (a coherent palette, not natural variety).
styles.intended: Broad brushy colour regions with little surface detail and deliberately leaning or chunky forms are the style, not low-resolution textures or modelling errors.

missing: hand-painted textures and shaped, exaggerated forms on the characters and props (the cook paints a model's own colour textures; untextured blockouts stay flat)

authored.what: shaped and exaggerated forms (big hands, tapered limbs, chunky silhouettes) with hand-painted colour textures: brush strokes and painted light in the texture, no photographic detail
exaggerated, slightly lopsided forms with hand-painted colour textures: painted edges and light in the texture
hand-painted: visible brush strokes, painted highlights and shadows, no photographic detail

palette.rules: Two or three dominant hues per area; graded towards them.

assets.textureDensity: hand-painted, 0.5 to 1 texel per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Hand-painted textures, shaped forms, a painterly filter over the frame, a coherent graded palette.

styles.name: Cinematic realism
styles.descriptor: Believable materials, human proportions and natural light, organised by cinematic framing, depth and colour control.
checks: Materials respond physically: metals reflect the environment, rough surfaces scatter.
Lighting is naturalistic with soft shadows and indirect fill (ambient occlusion visible).
The frame is graded (a LUT or colour cast) and draws focus with light, depth of field or atmosphere outside the play area, which keeps full contrast.
styles.intended: A colour grade or cast, depth of field and atmosphere outside the play area are the style, not a white-balance error or focus fault; the play area itself keeps full contrast.

premise.genre: action adventure, open world, narrative drama

palette.rules: One grade per area; avoid oversaturation; skin tones protected.

assets.textureDensity: PBR textures 1 to 2 texels per screen pixel

artBible.direction: Physically based materials, natural light, film-like grading and lenses, composition from cinema.

styles.name: Muted theatrical light
styles.descriptor: Simplified 3D forms in restrained colour, lit by local beams and haze like a stage, where tonal layers tell the story.
checks: A capture's average saturation is low (below 0.25) with at most one saturated accent.
Light arrives in local beams or pools (god rays or spot lights) made visible by haze in their path, not by a fog over the whole frame.
Forms are simplified but keep volume (soft shading, no outlines).
styles.intended: Low saturation over the whole frame, dark areas outside the light beams and visible haze in the beams' path are the style, not a washed-out grade, underexposure or fog bugs.

palette.rules: Desaturated everything; the accent is red or warm light only where the story points.

artBible.direction: Stage lighting: dark grounds, beams through haze, simplified forms with soft volume, a single accent.

styles.name: Layered silhouettes
styles.descriptor: Foregrounds as solid contours against lighter, hazier layers behind, so shape and value carry the depth.
checks: The nearest layer is a near-uniform dark silhouette with no visible surface detail.
At least three depth layers are visible, each lighter than the one in front.
The player is identifiable by silhouette alone.
styles.intended: A near-black foreground with no surface detail and successively lighter, hazier layers behind are the style, not crushed shadows or missing textures.

palette.size: 1 hue in 4 to 6 values, or black plus a gradient sky
palette.rules: Value steps per layer; colour only in the far layers or a single accent.

artBible.direction: Black shapes in front, haze and light behind, readability by contour, depth by value steps.

styles.name: Minimal geometry
styles.descriptor: Rectangles, circles and triangles in a small set of colours, ordered by proportion, rhythm and empty space.
checks: Every element in a capture is a basic geometric shape or a simple composition of them.
A capture uses at most 6 colours.
At least 30 % of the frame is empty background.
styles.intended: Plain basic shapes, at most six colours and large empty areas are the style, not placeholder art or an unfinished background.

palette.rules: One ground, one figure colour, one accent; contrast by hue and value.

artBible.direction: Geometric primitives, flat colour, deliberate proportion, movement and spacing as the expression.

styles.name: Neon vector lines
styles.descriptor: Thin glowing lines, grids and bright particles on dark fields, like a vector display.
checks: Mean luminance of a capture is below 0.15 and line pixels are near full brightness.
Lines glow: a halo wider than the line itself (bloom).
Geometry is drawn as lines or wireframes, not filled surfaces.
styles.intended: A nearly black frame, thin full-brightness lines with halos and unfilled wireframe geometry are the style, not underexposure, bloom bleed or missing surfaces.

palette.rules: Each hue one meaning (player, enemy, pickup); white only for the hottest centres.

artBible.direction: Luminous lines on black, grids for space, particle bursts, bloom as the material.

styles.name: Monochrome dithered 3D
styles.descriptor: 3D scenes reduced to one or two colours where dot patterns carry every tonal transition while perspective stays real.
checks: A capture contains at most 2 to 4 colours.
Gradients are rendered as a visible ordered or noise dither pattern.
The scene keeps real 3D perspective and depth cues.
styles.intended: Two to four colours and a visible ordered or noise dither pattern in every gradient are the style, not banding, noise or a broken palette.

palette.rules: Ink and paper, optionally one mid-tone and one accent.

assets.textureDensity: textures nearly irrelevant: light carries value

artBible.direction: Real 3D lighting quantised to one bit, dither as the only shading, a low-resolution grid that keeps the pattern crisp.
avoid: dither that crawls when still (use a stable pattern)

styles.name: Luminous layered depths
styles.descriptor: Painterly side-on scenery in many foreground and background layers with strong luminous focal points against dark masses.
checks: At least four parallax layers are visible, foreground darkest.
Luminous focal points (glows, light shafts) stand against dark masses.
Layers behind the play plane fade by atmospheric perspective (lighter and cooler), and the play plane keeps full contrast.
styles.intended: Dark foreground masses, strong glowing focal points and far layers faded lighter and cooler are the style, not crushed shadows, bloom bleed or fog bugs.

missing: the art is content: characters 60 to 150 px, drawn for the style

authored.what: drawn for the style at 60 to 150 px tall: a glowing silhouette with soft inner light and luminous edges, readable against painted depths
painted in layered depths: a dark foreground silhouette, glowing midground and luminous misty background, light blooming between the layers

palette.size: dark cool masses plus warm luminous accents
palette.rules: Value structure first: dark foreground, mid play plane, glowing background.

artBible.direction: Deep side-on layers, glowing focal points, light shafts and bloom, atmospheric fade into the distance.
